Definition: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
BiblicalUsage: 1) to stretch out, extend, spread out, pitch, turn, pervert, incline, bend, bow; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stretch out, extend, stretch, offer; 1a2) to spread out, pitch (tent); 1a3) to bend, turn, incline; 1a3a) to turn aside, incline, decline, bend down; 1a3b) to bend, bow; 1a3c) to hold out, extend (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to be stretched out; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to stretch out; 1c2) to spread out; 1c3) to turn, incline, influence, bend down, hold out, extend, thrust aside, thrust away
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
